suspicions.analysis:
Logical mistakes: none found for the stated intent. The collision check runs after the uniqueness check and before auto-filling, so a user group is never overwritten; an int key equal to a column some group does list is not a collision. (Int keys sort by their string form, so 10 before 9; this is documented, intended behaviour and out of scope.)
Robustness omissions: a str key such as "3" plus an unlisted column 3 yields duplicate logical names (out of scope per intent: str keys behave as before). Empty groups are accepted. bool keys are not validated. Invalid column references rely on the column-resolution helper to raise.
